name: Super Productivity
title: Super Productivity: free Sunsama alternative
hook: Sunsama charges you seventeen dollars a month to plan your day and your to-dos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Sort tasks into projects and tags, then see your day on a schedule next to your calendar.
Time any task with a timer, Pomodoro focus mode and break reminders.

caption:
Sunsama charges $17/month to plan your day and your to-dos. Super Productivity does it for free ✅

✅ Projects, tags and sub-tasks for your to-do list
✅ A day schedule next to your calendar events
✅ Task timer, Pomodoro focus mode and break reminders
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · iPhone · Android · any browser
ℹ️ Syncing between devices uses SuperSync, Dropbox or WebDAV, and the browser version has a few limits vs the desktop app. Sunsama's $17/month is its annual price ($22 billed monthly)
